preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input text.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) >= 1 and lines[0].strip().isdigit() if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else False
preconditions.description: The first line of input contains a valid integer T representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(lines[i*2 + 1].strip()) == int(lines[i*2].strip()) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in lines[i*2 + 1].strip()) for i in range(int(lines[0].strip()))) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) and len(lines) >= 1 else False
preconditions.description: For each test case, the N-th line contains an integer N, and the following line contains a string S of length N consisting only of lowercase English alphabets.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.strip().splitlines()) == int(lines[0].strip()) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else False
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(out_line) == sorted(S) for out_line, S in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), [lines[i*2 + 1].strip() for i in range(int(lines[0].strip()))])) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else False
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string is a permutation of the input string S (same characters with same counts).

postconditions.expression: all(out_line <= S for out_line, S in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), [lines[i*2 + 1].strip() for i in range(int(lines[0].strip()))])) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else False
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string is lexicographically smaller than or equal to the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(all(not (ord(out_line[j]) < ord(S[j]) and any(ord(out_line[k]) < ord(S[k]) for k in range(j+1, len(S))) or (ord(out_line[j]) == ord(S[j]) and all(ord(out_line[k]) >= ord(S[k]) for k in range(j+1, len(S))))) for j in range(len(S))) for out_line, S in zip(stdout.strip().splitlines(), [lines[i*2 + 1].strip() for i in range(int(lines[0].strip()))])) if (lines := stdin.strip().splitlines()) else False
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output string is the lexicographically smallest reachable string under the given swap constraints (adjacent characters only).
